prerequisites: Ability to use a personal computer and its operating system as well as main office automation applications.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamental principles and concepts of procedural programming.
Know the syntax and features of the C language.
Use basic functions from the ANSI C library.
Develop simple programs using the procedural programming paradigm in C.
Read and comment on C code.
Identify and resolve errors occurring at both compile-time and runtime (debugging).
Evaluate simple C programs and solutions, identifying the most suitable approach for solving a specific computational problem.
Explain the solutions implemented in their programs using appropriate technical terminology.
Develop the ability to independently consult and explore the official documentation for the C language and libraries.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to programming using the C language
Basics of the C language syntax
assessment_rules: The assessment consists of a practical test where the student must develop a C program. The practical test includes a maximum of three exercises of increasing difficulty, and passing requires solving at least one. Students who pass the practical test receive a grade out of thirty, which they can accept or not. An optional oral test can be requested only if the practical test grade is higher than 26/30, and it may lead to a redetermination of the final grade.
